title: NO ONE HAD TOO MUCH OR TOO LITTLE

memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text:
"The Israelites did as they were told; some gathered much, some little. And when
they measured it by the omer, the one who gathered much did not have too much,
and the one who gathered little did not have too little. Everyone had gathered
just as much as they needed." - Ex 16:17-18 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
Here is the miracle inside the miracle. People gathered different amounts, and
when it was measured, everyone had exactly what they needed.

Think about who gathered much: the young, the strong, the quick. And who
gathered little: the elderly, the sick, the mother with three small children,
the man with a bad back. In any ordinary economy, that difference decides who
eats well and who goes hungry.

God levelled it. Effort differed; provision did not.

We should be careful not to turn this into a political programme; Scripture is
not handing us an economic system here. But it does reveal something about God's
heart. He is not content for the weak to go without simply because they could
not compete.

And it says something to both kinds of people. If you gathered much, you have
nothing to boast about; the surplus was never really yours. If you gathered
little, you are not overlooked; God made up the difference.

Paul applies this exact verse to the church's generosity (2 Cor 8:15). What God
did miraculously in the desert, He now often does through His people's giving.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. Do you credit your provision to your own capability?
2. Is God asking you to be the means by which someone else's need is met?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text:
Father, thank You that You measure by need and not by strength. Make me
generous, and keep me from boasting in what You provided. Amen.
